milestone.title: M1: On-chain Singular support for cardano-keri
milestone.description:
Implement and verify Singular on-chain registry, policies and application-facing contracts sufficiently for the exact agreed cardano-keri consumer interface. Freeze concrete bootstrap, script/policy bindings, encodings, witnesses and consumer transaction shapes before implementation. Deliver reproducible on-chain artifacts and independently verified consumer conformance; demonstrate bounded naming claims, optional payment addresses, next-key recovery and current-owner OR fixed-quorum permanent retirement. Naming/model simulation alone is insufficient. Existing operator-owned #10 remains foundational work with independent scope. Off-chain scope is transaction-building and devnet verification support; the indexer is excluded.; test-only fixtures/harnesses support verification. MPFS common-code factoring is a possible M2, not a prerequisite or founded milestone. No full KERI implementation, public-network launch or naming Delete/reuse. Epic #15 is the next planned model/contract/simulator release, starting with #20; source-and-lock copy #19 starts successor epic #16 with no compilation, followed by the remaining ordered epics; detailed implementation child tickets follow later. Scalus experiment #14 is postponed outside M1 as an open deferred backlog item, with no date or future milestone assigned. No production Scala or off-chain stack adoption is implied. No due date is assigned. Execution of epic #15 is now commissioned: #20 develops the naming model and simulator, followed by #21-25 in order. Subsequent ledger epics remain planned. The deferred experiment retains its bounded Haskell interoperability criteria for possible later reconsideration; no execution, technical disproof or permanent rejection is claimed. Ordered map: #15 contracts -> #16 claims/state -> #17 recovery/retirement -> #18 consumer conformance/release. Each epic is a vertical release within this milestone: #15 M1-specific docs simulator/contract package; #16 runnable on-chain claim/maintenance bundle; #17 recovery/permanent-retirement extension; #18 independently accepted consumer-conformance release. Each has its own versioned retrievable artifact, replay instructions, usable CI/release path and independent acceptance; release packaging is not postponed wholesale to the final epic. Each successor consumes the prior accepted release. No production off-chain service or indexer is commissioned.
